annotations.exact_quote: Since diverse views admit the same underlying cluster structure across multiple views, we use a new disagreement cost function for regularizing graphs from different views toward a common consensus.

annotations.exact_quote: We learn a consensus graph with minimizing disagreement between different views and constraining the rank of the Laplacian matrix.
